verdict.rationale: Lithic offers native Spend Limits per card/account for velocity control (daily/monthly/all-time caps) plus a separate Authorization Rules engine enforcing MCC/velocity/transaction-count rules at program, account, or card level, all evaluated platform-side during authorization rather than in customer code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming per-cardholder (vs per-account/card) scoping and independent/hands-on confirmation of exact window options (daily/monthly/all-time) beyond the docs' summary language.
